title: Flyto2 Core file modules and HTTP guards permit sandbox and network escapes
summary: Unguarded file-writing modules can write outside FLYTO_SANDBOX_DIR. HTTP helpers separately discard validated DNS addresses or follow pagination targets without revalidation, allowing readable requests to internal services.

severity.rationale: A caller able to run modules can overwrite host configuration or obtain internal data. Agent recipes can pass attacker-influenced paths and URLs.

exposure: Attackers must influence module or recipe arguments. DNS rebinding additionally requires attacker-controlled DNS and a resolution race; pagination needs a controlled response.

params.instructions: Check flyto-core version, affected release line and the documented exposure conditions.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade to 2.26.8 or later and verify both file confinement and outbound URL restrictions.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed release meets the corresponding fixed version and verify the affected workflow with harmless test inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
